analogous: Ana + logos: according to the ratio. Analogous cases.
Analogous: like a map and a territory.
antedate: Ante + date: earlier. This vase antedates Rome.
ascribe: Ad + scribere: write to. Ascribe the poem to Homer.
avert: A + vertere: turn away. Avert a crisis.
behoove: Behoof: advantage. It behooves you to apologise.
belittle: Be + little: make small. Don’t belittle my work.
besmirch: Be + smirch: stain. Besmirch his name.
buttress: Butt: push against. Flying buttresses hold up cathedrals.
cavalier: Cavalier: horseman. A cavalier attitude to safety.
cerebral: Cerebrum: brain. A cerebral film: thoughtful, not emotional.
coalesce: Co + alescere: grow together. Clouds coalesce.
cohesive: Co + haerere: stick together. A cohesive team.
consecrate: Con + sacrare: make sacred. Consecrate the church.
Consecrate: dedicate to a high purpose.
conundrum: Conundrum: a riddle. A tricky conundrum.
Conundrum: puzzle with no easy answer.
deride: De + ridere: laugh down. Deride his ideas.
eccentric: Ek + kentron: off-centre. An eccentric millionaire.
evenhanded: Even + hand: fair. An evenhanded ruling.
fawn: Fawn: cringe like a dog. Fawn over the boss.
foolhardy: Fol + hardi. A foolhardy climb without ropes.
forthright: Forth + right: straight ahead. A forthright answer.
glean: Glaner: gather leftovers. Gleaned from the reports.
Glean: pick up bits of info.
humdrum: Hum + drum: monotony. A humdrum routine.
implicate: In + plicare: fold in. Implicated in the scandal.
incense: Incendere: set on fire. Incensed by the insult.
incumbent: In + cumbere: lie on. The incumbent mayor; it is incumbent on you.
industrious: Industria: diligence. Industrious as an ant.
insipid: In + sapidus: no taste. Insipid soup.
intermittent: Inter + mittere: send between. Intermittent rain.
irascible: Ira: anger. An irascible old man.
lethargic: Lethe: forgetfulness. Lethargic in the heat.
melancholy: Melas + khole: black bile. Melancholy autumn.
precarious: Precarius: by prayer. A precarious ledge.
preempt: Pre + emere: buy first. Preempt the rival.
presumptuous: Presume: take for granted. A presumptuous question.
prevail: Prae + valere: be stronger. Reason prevails.
profusion: Pro + fundere: pour. A profusion of flowers.
rakish: Rake: a libertine. A rakish hat.
redress: Re + dress: put right. Redress a grievance.
rile: Rile: stir up. Rile the crowd.
tribulation: Tribulum: threshing sledge. Trials and tribulations.
uncanny: Un + canny: eerie. An uncanny resemblance.
veneer: Fournir: furnish. A veneer of politeness.
